headline: Olubadan hails Tinubu’s plan to revive Ibadan factory
summary: Nigerian President Bola Tinubu promised to reopen the Ibadan Leyland factory and repair roads, following a memorandum of understanding with a Chinese company. The Olubadan commended the plan.
why: Industrial plant revivals and foreign manufacturing partnerships affect Nigeria's industrial output, employment and investment climate. Such projects are closely watched by investors in Nigerian manufacturing.
